# Shramko Motor Autostart

> Betaflight 2025.12.1 firmware module by Andrii Shramko that turns a flight controller into a standalone motor / ESC driver: on power-up it waits for the battery, counts down, ramps the throttle linearly and holds it (optionally with random gusts, a run time and a LiPo cut-off) - no transmitter, receiver or switch. Configured in the Betaflight CLI or in the browser at https://autostart.flyreelstudio.eu (Web Serial). Built for the META4 Tornado storm-chasing camera case: a blower clears water from the 360 camera optics with nobody touching it. GPL-3.0-or-later.

## Key facts
- Ready firmware: HGLRC F405 8S V2 (Betaflight board_name HGLRC_F405_S8), file betaflight_2025.12.1_STM32F405_HGLRC_F405_S8_autostart.hex; ..._stock.hex is the same Betaflight without the module. Tested with a Flycolor X-Cross HV3 160A (BLHeli_32) on 6S.
- Other Betaflight boards: build from source with Docker; add #define USE_AUTOSTART to the board's config.h.
- Flash with https://app.betaflight.com -> Firmware Flasher -> Load Firmware [Local]. Windows "DFU device not found": ImpulseRC Driver Fixer or Zadig (WinUSB). The first boot after flashing resets settings once; the build's defaults are the project settings.
- Defaults: autostart_mode POWER, autostart_delay 10 s, autostart_ramp 100 (10.0 s), autostart_throttle 15 %, autostart_motors 15 (motors 1-4), autostart_vbat_min 60 (6.0 V). Firmware 1.1 adds autostart_pattern (STEADY / GUSTS), autostart_run_time, autostart_throttle_limit and the battery cut-off (autostart_cells, autostart_cell_cutoff, autostart_cutoff_time).
- Stops the program (never restarts by itself): entering the CLI, the Configurator Motors tab, arming via a receiver, a valid receiver link (unless autostart_box), run time over, battery cut-off, battery unplugged, a button click while running. Re-plugging the battery in POWER mode starts the countdown again.
- Measured on hardware: ramp starts 10.01 s after power-on, takes 10.02 s, max deviation 1 us; 76 unit tests + a randomized property test of the firmware state machine; every setting re-checked on the real board with a 6S pack (45 of 45, 2026-10-20).
- Web configurator browsers: Chrome, Edge, Opera on Windows/macOS/Linux. Firefox 151+ (one-time site permission). Android: Chrome 148+ with USB-OTG, only on phones whose Android supports USB serial (Google: limited set of devices). iPhone/iPad: not possible.
